# README header assets

Light and dark headers used at the top of the repository `README.md` (same pattern as Externa, Excubia and laravel-oidc).

Built from the Signaculum brand kit (`projects/qiick/brand/src/signaculum/`, Externa-style card via `extras.py`) and copied from `projects/qiick/brand/rollout/repos/signaculum-core/.github/assets/`.

- `header-light.svg` / `header-dark.svg` — 1280×320 README `<picture>` sources
- `header-light.png` / `header-dark.png` — raster counterparts
